description.value: A cross-sectional quantitative MRI study evaluating basal ganglia changes across the ALS–ALS-FTD continuum using volumetric, shape, density, and neuropsychological correlation analyses.

spans.text: To evaluate basal ganglia changes along the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)–ALS–frontotemporal dementia (FTD) continuum using multiple, complementary imaging techniques.
